abstract_title: What we Learned from Controlled Mind-Discovery/Telepathy Trials with Six Nonspeaking Autistic Co-Researchers
abstract: Co-Authors: Julia Mossbridge, Maria Welch, Natalia Meehan, Polly Washburn, Joseph Mossbridge, Damon Abraham, and Jeff Tarrant; Nonspeaking Co-Researchers: Evan, Ashley, Akhil, Ryan, Dima, Sawyer Nonspeaking autistic individuals (“nonspeakers”) don’t communicate reliably with speech, but some utilize alternative communication by spelling out their words on letterboards or keyboards ("spelling") with a CRP (communication regulation partner) to regulate their apraxic bodies.
